answer: Clone factories fail a pour they cannot pre-cast. A joiner bonds 12.60 POA and books one crucible for a 6-minute pour of 48 grams of copper into a mold whose 23-bit sprue id was drawn 25 minutes earlier. Mid-pour, a nebula pyrometer fires three 1.4-second heat samples 40 seconds apart; the cooling curve must pass a published prism of 8 temperature gates (±2.5 C) signed by two non-kin witnesses. Peers rehash the curve and refuse a second pour on that sprue. Cost: 12.60 POA plus one live pour. A pre-cast ingot, curve miss, or sprue collision burns 71% and cools the crucible for six epochs.
